summary.goal: Add the node-graph screenshot as a banner image at the top of the README
decisions: Placed the banner at docs/banner.png (moved from the repo-root nodes.png paste) and referenced it via an absolute raw.githubusercontent.com/maxrios/memex/main URL so it renders both on GitHub and on the crates.io README, matching the existing absolute github.com links in the file.

rejected_approaches.description: Reference the banner with a relative path (docs/banner.png)
rejected_approaches.reason: Relative image paths do not resolve on the crates.io README render; the absolute raw URL works on both GitHub and crates.io, consistent with the existing absolute links in the file.

open_threads: The raw URL pins to the main branch, so the banner only resolves once docs/banner.png is merged to main — it will 404 on the branch/PR preview until then.
